family.name: rotated_cap_multi_mode_u_space
family.mode_form_curved: A_k = { u . n_k > h_k + c (v_k - o_k)^2 } (H3-2 surface family)
family.label_precedence: ascending mode index, later index overwrites earlier (frozen label_curved semantics)
family.initial_proposal_rule: single unit-Gaussian component at the primary mode nearest-boundary design point z* = h_1 * n_1 (frozen rule); missing-mode apex points used only for the offline reference strata
family.curvature_allowed_on: missing modes only; probability CURVED_PROB per mode, amplitude fixed

batch_2_fallback.trigger: fewer than 8 eligible configs after all earlier batches exhausted

candidate_generation.determinism: np.random.SeedSequence([batch_seed, batch_index]) -> spawn children for cfg/mc/is/boot streams

stratified_is.allocation: equal strata over the 4 mode-apex components, unit covariance

estimators.P_ref: (1/K) sum_s mean_s( exp(log p - log r) 1_{A_k} )
estimators.L_ref: (1/K) sum_s mean_s( exp(2 log p - log q0 - log r) 1_{A_k} ) (task Sec. 29 estimator)

reference_characterization.cross_check: plain-MC P_hat under p recorded per candidate (P_ref_mc_crosscheck); analytic anchors recorded for linear caps (diagnostic only)

eligibility.source_of_truth: reference characterization only (benchmark-design oracle, task Sec. 9.1)

freeze_rule.order: sort eligible configs by config_id ascending across batches (batch_seed asc, then batch_index asc -- zero-padded ids make string order equal this order)
